6.13 rsCompilerErrorInClassInstanceDeclaration
rsCompilerErrorInClassInstanceDeclaration is a critical error that occurs whenever a compile error
occurs in a Class instance. For example, if Class.ClassName is set to "Math", but the System.Math
class has no constructors, this error will occur.
